newsitem.title: RUSSIA: One killed, one hurt in Moscow blast.
newsitem.headline: One killed, one hurt in Moscow blast.

text.p: A man was killed and his wife badly injured when a large bomb exploded in the lift of a Moscow apartment block in the early hours of Friday, police said.

Itar-Tass news agency said the bomb, composed of an estimated 800 grams (two lbs) of high explosive, destroyed the lift and damaged landings on three floors in the building. Wreckage was drenched in blood.
The dead man was named as Alexander Privalov from the northern port city of Arkhangelsk.
The bomb was the latest in a series of mystery bomb attacks in Moscow in recent months.
Four people were killed on an underground (subway) train in June, days before the first round of the presidential election.
More than 30 people were hurt in two blasts on crowded trolleybuses in July.
Three passers-by were injured last Sunday when a small car bomb went off outside a shopping centre.
